company.name: Drive Terra
company.shortDescription: Drive Terra is an electric mobility technology company that provides battery-swapping infrastructure.
company.description: Drive Terra is a Dubai-based electric mobility technology company that provides battery-swapping infrastructure and electric vehicles for last-mile delivery fleets. The company focuses on helping logistics and delivery businesses transition from fuel-powered vehicles to zero-emission electric two- and three-wheelers with minimal downtime.

productsAndServices.description: Battery-swapping stations replace depleted batteries with charged ones for electric delivery vehicles, reducing charging downtime and supporting continuous fleet operation.
productsAndServices.name: Battery Swapping Infrastructure

productsAndServices.description: A cloud platform for monitoring battery-swapping stations and managing connected energy assets through telemetry, maintenance, and energy-management functions.
productsAndServices.name: Terra Cloud

productsAndServices.description: Fleet-management software providing driver scoring, route optimization, demand prediction, and anomaly detection for electric delivery operations.
productsAndServices.name: Fleet Intelligence

productsAndServices.description: A battery subscription service that lets electric two-wheeler operators use Terra batteries and swapping stations without purchasing or managing the battery fleet.
productsAndServices.name: Battery as a Service (BaaS)

productsAndServices.description: A subscription offering that combines Terra electric bikes, batteries, and battery swapping for commercial riders and fleet deployments.
productsAndServices.name: Mobility as a Service (MaaS)

productsAndServices.description: A regional expansion service that enables local partners to operate Terra battery-swapping stations and fleets using Terra technology, training, and supply-chain support.
productsAndServices.name: Terra Franchise Model
